entities.summary: Berik Abdrakhmanov is a Kazakhstani amateur boxer in the lightweight division who competed at the 2013 World Championships, won the Bronze medal along with Domenico Valentino of Italy. He also represented Kazakhstan at the 2016 Summer Olympics.
